description: Switch the ZapX parking page of a domain with ZapX nameservers on or off (A records on '@', 'www' and '*'). If switching on would replace own records, nothing is written and the result lists them under replace with needsConfirmation=true; call again with their ids in confirmedReplaceRecordIds. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

confirm.description: Must be true to apply the change.

confirmedReplaceRecordIds.description: Ids of the own records the previous call listed under `replace` (switching on only).

enabled.description: true = show the ZapX parking page, false = remove it.

name: set_domain_parking_page
title: Set Domain Parking Page
